verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud deployment platform, so deploying Docker containers is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions Docker, Dockerfiles, container images or registries. The documented deploy paths (repo connect with auto-config, CLI deploy, one-click templates) are generic and never state container support, so there is no evidence for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy applications packaged as Docker containers
